    • setPassiveInteraction

      public static void setPassiveInteraction(org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.part.PartPos partPos, org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.part.aspect.IAspectWrite<?,?> aspect, boolean passiveInteraction, boolean ignoreFilter)
      Configure the passive interaction properties of the given aspect within the given part.
      Parameters:
      partPos - The position of the part.
      aspect - The active aspect of the part.
      passiveInteraction - If passive interaction should be allowed.
      ignoreFilter - If passive interaction should ignore the aspect's filter.

      Configure the match block property of the given aspect within the given part.
      Parameters:

      aspect - The active aspect of the part.
      matchBlock - If the to-be-broken block should be matched instead of the items it would drop.
